info.title: CleanExtract
info.description: Convert public HTML or a public URL into token-dense Markdown. The first 3 calls per source IP are free, total, with no signup or claim header; the allowance does not reset. Later successful extractions cost USD 0.05 through x402 v2 USDC on Base.

post.summary: Extract Markdown from HTML or a public URL

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Optional for the first 3 calls per source IP. After the free allowance, send the base64-encoded x402 v2 payment payload returned after satisfying the 402 challenge.

url_or_html.description: A public HTTP(S) URL or raw HTML string.

200.description: Extraction succeeded. Free responses include X-Stringer-Free-Remaining; settled paid responses include PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

400.description: Invalid input or a blocked URL.

402.description: The 3-call source-IP allowance is exhausted or the caller cannot be identified. Read PAYMENT-REQUIRED for the x402 v2 challenge.

502.description: The public upstream could not be fetched safely.
